title: Proposed Standard panel — one adjustment behind every Standard choice
lede: Every choice the Standard view offers gains at least one Standard control that adjusts it. Thirteen promotions, no demotions, no section moves. Each panel below is the Standard roster as the registry would evaluate it under that choice — generated from flower-registry.js with the proposal applied in memory, so it shows what the panel would actually do, not a drawing of it.

views.title: 1 — ARRANGEMENT: FAN
views.sub: bloomType = bilateral · gains Petals per side

views.title: 5 — EDGE: TOOTHED
views.sub: tipStyle = jagged · gains the Amount slot (tipLength)

views.title: 6 — EDGE: SCALLOPED
views.sub: tipStyle = scallop · gains the Amount slot (scallopHeight)

views.title: REFERENCE — EDGE: RUFFLED
views.sub: tipStyle = ruffled · already works today (edgeNoise). Unchanged by this proposal — the pattern the two above copy.

views.title: 10 — CENTER: PETALOID FILL
views.sub: centerArch = petaloid · gains Outer fill size

views.title: 11 — SEPALS
views.sub: sepalsType = sepals · gains Sepal size AND Sepal count (the one two-control row)

views.title: 12 — LEAVES: COMPOUND
views.sub: stem + leafType = compound · gains Leaf size
